source.method: Map exact persisted PASS names/committed revisions, then read the exact c7 browser script to bound what each assertion actually checks. No run/download/replay was repeated.

groups.observation: The host created an explicitly marked unlisted rehearsal event through the actual DOM/Worker path. The same event title and ID survived an actual browser reload and fresh snapshot.
limits: One rehearsal event only; other setup branches, account cohorts, sign-in return, other entry routes and mobile devices were not established.
Committed revisions and reload support persistence for this operation; they do not prove every transactional/race/recovery clause.

groups.observation: Nine signed-in fixtures used host-created invitation links: six debater invitations, two judge invitations and one observer invitation. The link assertion checked the same origin and correct event; all nine claims were acknowledged.
limits: The check name mentions a secret link, but its explicit assertion checks origin and event linkage. Actual successful claiming confirms usable invitations, not entropy, expiry, revocation, guessing resistance or every privilege restriction.
No invitation email was sent and inbox delivery remains open.

groups.observation: Before host admission, each of the nine invited identities received an awaiting-admission snapshot containing one member and no matches or motions. Eight other workspace tabs remained disabled.
limits: The disabled tabs are DOM evidence; the separate restricted snapshot is the bounded backend evidence. Neither proves every direct endpoint, provider subscription, cross-event query or role forgery is denied.
Debate waiting-state evidence does not prove Study Room admission or Library policy.
The explicit assertion counts one member but does not independently compare that member ID; the test name alone does not strengthen that assertion.

groups.observation: The host admitted each of the nine invited fixtures. After an actual refresh, awaiting-admission cleared and the People workspace became available.
limits: Positive admissions only; removal/re-entry, reassignment, stale sessions and media grants were not exercised.

groups.observation: The host confirmed two named teams with three distinct assigned speakers each and selected the first assigned speaker as captain. Both confirm_roster commands returned committed revisions.
limits: No captain-proposed roster, fourth-speaker refusal, optional affiliation/reserve, substitution, conflict declaration or overlapping-match denial was exercised.

groups.observation: Five organizer-supplied private motion records were added through the DOM and acknowledged as five distinct committed commands.
limits: This is motion-bank creation, not five completed matches, inter-match isolation, sequential continuation or measured concurrency.

groups.observation: The host generated the two-team round-robin fixture, reached the draft-review display and explicitly published it. The subsequent match dialog fixed both teams and its motion to the published fixture.
limits: One two-team fixture only; five-team/10-match scheduling, byes, elimination, reuse policy, side balance and conflict handling were not verified.
The draft-review screenshot was captured but not visually reviewed by this mapping task.

groups.observation: A fixture match assigned the neutral host as its single judge. Six speakers checked in; six explicit organizer accommodations stated that physical audio was not verified.
